about: Where SF's injury crashes happen, by the kind of place a fix acts on: each size_families group's people hurt and KSI people at signalized and unsignalized corners, all-way stops, the High Injury Network, each street class and stress level, school zones, Slow Streets, 20 mph blocks, speed camera corridors, candidate low-traffic cells, night and day, by turn movement, and SF's count of each kind of place.

all_way_stops.how: unsignalized intersections whose stop signs face every block meeting there (a floor: one-way streets miss)
all_way_stops.source: DataSF 4542-gpa3 (stop signs, status L left out), read 2026-11-27

arterial_collector_miles.how: arterial, major and collector miles, a divided street counted once

arterial_intersections.how: intersections an arterial or major street meets (nodes; 1092 with a divided street's two crossings counted once)

arterial_miles.how: arterial and major street miles (classcode 2, 3), a divided street counted once

collector_miles.how: collector street miles (classcode 4), a divided street counted once

hin2022_miles.how: sum of corrected_length_miles over the 2022 HIN's blocks

hin_corners.how: intersections at an end of a 2024 HIN block, a divided street's two crossings counted once (1895 nodes)

hin_miles.how: sum of corrected_length_miles over the 2024 HIN's blocks

hin_signalized_corners.how: 2024 HIN corners with a signal, counted once (863 nodes)

hin_single_lane_miles.how: corrected_length_miles over the 2024 HIN's blocks with 1 off-peak lane (SFMTA MTA.CTA_trafficlanes LANES_OP: one a direction on a two-way street, one on a one-way street); dual-carriageway rows left out

hin_unsignalized_corners.how: 2024 HIN corners with no signal, counted once (1032 nodes)

intersections.how: nodes where two or more named streets meet

limit20_miles.how: surface miles posted 20 mph today, a divided street counted once

local_unsignalized_intersections.how: intersections where only residential streets meet, with no signal, a divided street's two crossings counted once (4398 nodes)
local_unsignalized_intersections.source: DataSF 3psu-pn9h, active surface blocks, read 2026-11-27; DataSF ybh5-27n2, types CALTRANS, CALTRANS (BY CONTRACTOR CONSORTIUM GLC), SIGNAL, SIGNAL (CONTRACTOR MAINTAINED), read 2026-11-27

ltn_cell_miles.how: street miles inside those cells, a divided street counted once

ltn_cell_residential_miles.how: residential street miles inside those cells, a divided street counted once

ltn_cells.how: candidate low-traffic cells of at least 0.5 miles of street (this script's rule)
ltn_cells.source: DataSF 3psu-pn9h, active surface blocks, read 2026-11-27; SFMTA 2023 draft BCI (data/extract/sfmta-bci/scores.json, read 2026-10-04)

multilane_arterial_collector_miles.how: arterial, major and collector miles with 2 or more off-peak lanes (SFMTA MTA.CTA_trafficlanes LANES_OP), a divided street counted once
multilane_arterial_collector_miles.source: DataSF 3psu-pn9h, active surface blocks, read 2026-11-27; SFMTA MTA.CTA_trafficlanes read 2026-11-25

residential_collector_miles.how: residential and collector miles, a divided street counted once

residential_miles.how: residential street miles (classcode 5), a divided street counted once

schools.how: active schools, every entity type but Preschool; a 500 ft zone each

signalized_arterial_intersections.how: intersections an arterial or major street meets, with a signal
signalized_arterial_intersections.source: DataSF 3psu-pn9h, active surface blocks, read 2026-11-27; DataSF ybh5-27n2, types CALTRANS, CALTRANS (BY CONTRACTOR CONSORTIUM GLC), SIGNAL, SIGNAL (CONTRACTOR MAINTAINED), read 2026-11-27

signalized_intersections.source: DataSF ybh5-27n2, types CALTRANS, CALTRANS (BY CONTRACTOR CONSORTIUM GLC), SIGNAL, SIGNAL (CONTRACTOR MAINTAINED), read 2026-11-27

signalized_limit35_intersections.how: intersections with a signal where a block posted 35 mph or more meets (3t7b-gebn today, status L left out)
signalized_limit35_intersections.source: DataSF ybh5-27n2, types CALTRANS, CALTRANS (BY CONTRACTOR CONSORTIUM GLC), SIGNAL, SIGNAL (CONTRACTOR MAINTAINED), read 2026-11-27; DataSF 3t7b-gebn

slip_lanes.how: no city dataset of slip lanes (channelized right turns) was found in the DataSF catalog on 2026-11-25

slow_street_miles.how: miles of Implemented Slow Street blocks (hkz3-itiu, last edited 2024-01-18)

speed_camera_corridor_miles.how: miles of camera corridor blocks, a divided street counted once

speed_camera_sites.how: speed camera site ids placed on a block (the street lane's rule): one id per direction of travel, at 41 distinct points; SFMTA counts the same cameras as 33 locations, the count its cost per location is for

stop_controlled_intersections.how: unsignalized intersections with at least one stop sign
stop_controlled_intersections.source: DataSF 4542-gpa3 (stop signs, status L left out), read 2026-11-27

surface_miles.how: every active surface street mile (no freeway, ramp or class 0), a divided street counted once

two_lane_arterial_collector_miles.how: arterial, major and collector miles with exactly 2 off-peak lanes (SFMTA MTA.CTA_trafficlanes LANES_OP: two a direction on a two-way street; a one-way street with two lanes is in too, since the layer does not mark one-way streets), a divided street counted once
two_lane_arterial_collector_miles.source: DataSF 3psu-pn9h, active surface blocks, read 2026-11-27; SFMTA MTA.CTA_trafficlanes read 2026-11-25

two_way_or_partial_stops.how: unsignalized intersections with some but not all approaches stopped
two_way_or_partial_stops.source: DataSF 4542-gpa3 (stop signs, status L left out), read 2026-11-27

uncontrolled_intersections.how: intersections with no signal and no stop sign
uncontrolled_intersections.source: DataSF 4542-gpa3 (stop signs, status L left out), read 2026-11-27

unposted_25_miles.how: surface miles with speedlimit 0, the 25 mph default, a divided street counted once

unposted_residential_miles.how: residential miles with speedlimit 0, the 25 mph default, a divided street counted once

unsignalized_arterial_intersections.how: intersections an arterial or major street meets, with no signal
unsignalized_arterial_intersections.source: DataSF 3psu-pn9h, active surface blocks, read 2026-11-27; DataSF ybh5-27n2, types CALTRANS, CALTRANS (BY CONTRACTOR CONSORTIUM GLC), SIGNAL, SIGNAL (CONTRACTOR MAINTAINED), read 2026-11-27

unsignalized_intersections.source: DataSF 3psu-pn9h, active surface blocks, read 2026-11-27; DataSF ybh5-27n2, types CALTRANS, CALTRANS (BY CONTRACTOR CONSORTIUM GLC), SIGNAL, SIGNAL (CONTRACTOR MAINTAINED), read 2026-11-27
